title: 第2章 本命卡
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
人群开始向前涌动，很快就轮到那个老爷子了。

    林奇站在不远处，刚好能看清觉醒台上的场景。

    只见老爷子双手撑着膝盖，颤巍巍地走上台，在主教的指引下，将枯瘦的手掌按在了台中央那枚拳头大小的紫水晶上。

    几乎是手掌贴上水晶的瞬间，一抹柔和的白光从紫水晶中亮起，顺着他的手掌蔓延至手臂，最终在他胸口凝聚成一道淡淡的光团。

    教堂主教脸上露出欣慰的笑容，上前一步拍了拍老爷子的肩膀。

    “恭喜你啊，老约翰！在八十七岁的高龄，成功觉醒了本命卡，这份毅力，连源卡之神都会为之动容。”

    老约翰的眼眶瞬间红了，眼泪顺着皱纹滑落。

    他紧紧握住主教的双手，声音因激动而颤抖。

    “我就知道…… 我就知道我一定有成为御卡师的资质！几十年了，我每天都在感受源力，从未放弃…… 现在，我终于成功了！成功了啊……”

    突然得到一生都在梦寐以求的东西，这让他的情绪十分激动。

    主教见状，连忙扶住他，对着台下高声喊道：

    “老约翰的家属在吗？快带他下去平复情绪，别让老人家太激动。”

    “家属在这！”

    人群中，之前和林奇搭话的大叔立刻挤了过来。

    他一个箭步冲上台，稳稳扶住老约翰，语气又急又喜：“爹，您先别急着哭啊，咱们先看看觉醒的是什么本命卡，这才是正经事！”

    此言一出，台下所有人的目光都齐刷刷地聚焦在老约翰身上，连之前低头祈祷的人都忍不住探出头来。

    八十七岁觉醒本命卡，本身就是件奇事，要是能觉醒一张好卡，那可就真是传奇了！

    “在熔岩王国也有厚积薄发的例子，据说隔壁公国有个男爵，他四十岁那年才觉醒本命卡，一觉醒就是稀有的蓝色卡，后来加入了王国的军队，仅仅十年就成为了一位御卡大师！”
content_en:
The crowd began to move forward, and soon it was the old man's turn.

    Lin Qi stood not far away, just enough to see the scene on the awakening stage.

    I saw the old man holding his knees with both hands, walking tremblingly onto the stage, and under the guidance of the bishop, he pressed his skinny palms on the fist-sized amethyst in the center of the stage.

    Almost the moment his palm touched the crystal, a soft white light lit up from the amethyst, spread along his palm to his arm, and finally condensed into a faint light ball on his chest.

    The bishop of the church showed a gratified smile, stepped forward and patted the old man on the shoulder.

    "Congratulations, Old John! At the age of eighty-seven, you have successfully awakened your natal card. This perseverance will move even the God of Source Cards."

    Old John's eyes turned red instantly, and tears slid down his wrinkles.

    He held the bishop's hands tightly, his voice trembling with emotion.

    "I knew... I knew I must have the qualifications to become a card master! For decades, I have felt the source of power every day and never gave up... Now, I finally succeeded! I succeeded..."

    Suddenly getting something he had dreamed of all his life made him very emotional.

    Seeing this, the bishop quickly supported him and shouted to the audience:

    "Are Old John's family members here? Take him down quickly to calm down, don't make the old man too excited."

    "The family is here!"

    In the crowd, the uncle who had previously spoken to Lin Qi immediately squeezed over.

    He rushed up to the stage, held Old John firmly, and said in an anxious and happy tone: "Dad, don't cry in a hurry. Let's see what natal card has been awakened first. This is serious business!"

    As soon as these words came out, everyone's eyes in the audience were all focused on Old John, and even those who had bowed their heads in prayer couldn't help but poke their heads out.

    Awakening your natal card at the age of eighty-seven is a miracle in itself. If you can awaken a good card, it will be truly legendary!

    "There are also examples of people who have accumulated a lot of experience in the Lava Kingdom. It is said that there is a baron in the principality next door. He only awakened his natal card when he was forty years old. When he awakened, he had a rare blue card. Later he joined the kingdom's army and became a card master in just ten years!"
